meta.title: Subscriptions Enhanced
meta.description: Focused enhancement of dsh-plugin-subscriptions 0.9.13. Antigravity stops immediately on quota errors without a guessed five-minute cooldown; transient failures retry at most twice. Gemini omits the fixed Harness identity opener and uses neutral application wording in Creator. All four selected modes keep their existing capabilities; no automatic Minimal switching. Original account management, model settings, quotas, network transport and other subscriptions are retained. Enable this bundle instead of the original subscriptions bundle.
